verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents AI browser agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, BrowserUse) running in managed cloud sessions, started with a single API call and requiring no infrastructure management. That covers hosted task submission without the user managing a browser. However, the pack never documents how results come back: there is no task-status polling endpoint and no registrable webhook callback. missing for 10: documented polling/status-retrieval endpoint for agent tasks, webhook callbacks on task completion, independent hands-on corroboration of the agent task API.
